Cricket Nets | Handball Court | Volleyball Court | Throwball Court | Kabaddi Court | Kho Kho Court

  • Cricket Field: Cricket is widely played sports and most popular sport in our country. The campus has a playground of 9900 Sq.Mtr. This play field is also used for Football, Softball and many other games.
  • Basketball / Tennis Court: ATME College of Engineering has added another feather to its cap, with Synthetic Basketball / Tennis Courts of International Standards in its campus.
  [/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="INDOOR FACILITIES" tab_id="1652253665030-d9b37e64-8af4"][vc_column_text]

Carrom  | Table Tennis | Chess | Yoga Hall

  • Multi Gymnasium: Other main attraction for the students at ATME college of Engineering is MULTI Gym in the campus. Students and staffs can make use of Gym facilities during their free time.
  [/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column][/vc_row]
